method: Full 128-output-token call after two warmups. CUDA events surround operations; host timers cover API submission/CPU work. Pending GPU intervals are completed at existing argmax dependency boundaries using an explicit profiler readiness wait. Intervals include queue idle/submission gaps and are not kernel-active time. Host wall and GPU intervals overlap and must not be summed. Profiling overhead makes total wall unsuitable for performance claims. Counts cover explicit source launches and cuBLAS API calls; physical cuBLAS kernel counts require external profiling.
